Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Amit Mahajan
 Order

The present bail application is filed by the applicant seeking regular bail in FIR No. 890/2023 dated 07.12.2023, registered at Police Station New Usmanpur for offences under Sections 306 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 ('IPC').
Chargesheet has been filed in the present case under Sections 306/376 of the IPC and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
2. Issue notice.
3. The learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State accepts notice.

4. Let the Status Report be filed before the next date of hearing.
5.
The nominal roll of the applicant be also requisitioned from the concerned Jail Superintendent before the next date of hearing.
This is a digitally signed order.

Issue notice to the complainant through the Investigating Officer, returnable on the next date of hearing.
